signals.Signal the user needs: Why a read failed
signals.What the device does: Names the blocker: too small, too blurry, not enough light
signals.What the absence costs: The user can act on it. Move, relight, retake

signals.Signal the user needs: How to re-aim during a capture
signals.What the device does: Spoken coaching. Move closer, turn to the light, stay still, got it
signals.What the absence costs: Closes the aiming loop the user cannot close by eye

signals.Signal the user needs: Light too poor for an accurate answer
signals.What the device does: States the limit before giving the answer
signals.What the absence costs: The answer arrives pre-discounted, which is what a caveat is for

signals.Signal the user needs: Where the answer came from
signals.What the device does: Names the website behind the answer
signals.What the absence costs: Named by participants as the thing that raises trust

signals.Signal the user needs: That the command was heard
signals.What the device does: The beep. Listening-state confirmation
signals.What the absence costs: Absence of the beep is the retry signal

signals.Signal the user needs: That the request is refused
signals.What the device does: States the refusal and often the reason
signals.What the absence costs: The one failure the device reliably narrates. Task moves to a human

signals.Signal the user needs: That a correction was accepted
signals.What the device does: User says that is wrong, device rechecks and revises
signals.What the absence costs: Only reachable by a user who already suspected the error

signals.Signal the user needs: Confidence in the answer just given
signals.What the device does: None. Wrong answers arrive in the same voice as right ones
signals.What the absence costs: The central defect. Hedging is named as the missing feature

signals.Signal the user needs: That content was dropped from a read
signals.What the device does: None. The summary sounds complete
signals.What the absence costs: User believes they have the whole document

signals.Signal the user needs: That the subject is outside the frame
signals.What the device does: None before the answer. Nothing confirms the subject is in shot
signals.What the absence costs: A partial capture is read out as if complete

signals.Signal the user needs: That the answer describes an older frame
signals.What the device does: None. Both answers are plausible
signals.What the absence costs: A correct description attaches to the wrong object

signals.Signal the user needs: That an absence is a limit and not a fact
signals.What the device does: None. A bare no is delivered as knowledge
signals.What the absence costs: Nothing there and I cannot tell are said with the same words

signals.Signal the user needs: Whether it is recording
signals.What the device does: A light the wearer cannot see
signals.What the absence costs: Clip lost, or recorded while the user believed it was not

signals.Signal the user needs: Charge and pairing state
signals.What the device does: A coloured light on the case, visual only
signals.What the absence costs: Runtime cannot be planned around

signals.Signal the user needs: What changed in an update
signals.What the device does: No accessible changelog
signals.What the absence costs: Capabilities appear and vanish with no announcement the user can read

signals.Signal the user needs: Which phrasing would have worked
signals.What the device does: None. Half the job is finding the wording
signals.What the absence costs: Failure is indistinguishable from asking wrongly

signals.Signal the user needs: That the user is being read as sighted
signals.What the device does: None. The answer is positioned for someone who can see
signals.What the absence costs: Right in front of you carries no distance. Bystanders stop signalling

signals.Signal the user needs: Which item has focus, what is changing
signals.What the device does: None. A still frame cannot hold a change
signals.What the absence costs: Colour of an indicator reported, behaviour of it not

signals.Signal the user needs: User absorbs the failure as personal error
signals.What the device does: Operator error is the default reading of a silent failure
signals.What the absence costs: A product problem is carried as a personal one

signals.Signal the user needs: No witness available to check
signals.What the device does: Nobody on hand, so reliability is unknowable in principle
signals.What the absence costs: Verification is absent rather than skipped

signals.Signal the user needs: Trust confined to what is already known
signals.What the device does: Prior knowledge, the cane, or calibration on known answers
signals.What the absence costs: The device is trusted precisely where it adds least

signals.Signal the user needs: Task ruled out in advance, no failure on record
signals.What the device does: Never attempted, so nothing registers as a failure
signals.What the absence costs: The largest cost is the one the logs cannot show

signals.Signal the user needs: Accuracy judged against no access at all
signals.What the device does: Better than what I had before, so an unknown error rate is acceptable
signals.What the absence costs: The comparison class is no information, not a correct answer

signals.Signal the user needs: A human substitutes for the missing signal
signals.What the device does: Be My Eyes, Aira, a sighted person, a second app
signals.What the absence costs: The verification layer is staffed by people, not by the product
